content.comment_body: Is it possible to configure an on-delay time using the voltage from an analog input?
You can utilize the reference function for on-delay settings, allowing an analog value to control the timing.
Yes, this is achievable. See the attached demo for further details.
There's also an example available at [url]. Inside the .ZIP file labeled "Convert counter value/analog value into time format" you'll find additional guidance.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants confirm that on-delay timing can be set using an analog input voltage, referencing a specific function to enable this. They provide access to documentation and practical examples, and no significant issues or dissatisfaction with the product are reported.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for dynamic configuration of on-delay time based on analog input signals and expects straightforward instructions for implementation.
